scope: Two separately trained single-property OE62 point policies; three inference seeds, not independent training seeds. Raw-pool evidence separated from ranking/relaxation.

protocol.scope: Fresh trajectories per target and seed; common random streams across targets. One frozen trained checkpoint per property, not independent training repetitions.
protocol.timing: CUDA synchronized stage wall time; model load and warmup excluded. Raw evaluation includes in-domain and OOD valid molecules. Geometry only on up to 8 DPA-ranked in-domain correct-condition candidates.
protocol.off_control: One independent unconditional pool per seed, rescored against every requested target; no fake new draws per rescoring.
protocol.geometry: Fixed graph L-BFGS maxstep .025 A, max150 steps; stop RMS<=.1 and maxforce<=.15 eV/A. No target gradient.

protocol.scope: Fresh trajectories per target and seed; common random streams across targets. One frozen trained checkpoint per property, not independent training repetitions.
protocol.timing: CUDA synchronized stage wall time; model load and warmup excluded. Raw evaluation includes in-domain and OOD valid molecules. Geometry only on up to 8 DPA-ranked in-domain correct-condition candidates.
protocol.off_control: One independent unconditional pool per seed, rescored against every requested target; no fake new draws per rescoring.
protocol.geometry: Fixed graph L-BFGS maxstep .025 A, max150 steps; stop RMS<=.1 and maxforce<=.15 eV/A. No target gradient.
